outlook.discussion: 1. Western Central Pacific: A broad area of low pressure located near or just west of the International Date Line, several hundred miles west of Johnston Atoll, is producing disorganized showers and thunderstorms. Environmental conditions could support some slow development while the system moves generally eastward to east-northeastward. Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
